ptzCameras.notes: Telycam Explore Gen2 flagship. Sony 4/3 inch 9MP UHD CMOS, 20x optical, f=9.79 to 186.5mm, F2.8 to F4.5. HFOV 71 deg (wide) to 4.05 deg (tele); lens and HFOV Telycam-published (product page plus 2026 catalog). App renders from published HFOV. Published wide HFOV plus focal imply an effective 16:9 imaging width near 13.97mm (1 inch class), narrower than a nominal 4/3 inch; sensorWidthMM and sensorHeightMM are effective 16:9 values derived from the published wide HFOV and focal (working values pending manufacturer confirmation on whether 4K capture windows the 4/3 inch sensor). Built-in variable ND. Part TLC-900-IP-20-4K(NDI)-AB-G2.

Telycam Explore Gen2, professional broadcast AV tier. Shares the flagship optical block: Sony 4/3 inch 9MP UHD CMOS, 20x optical, f=9.79 to 186.5mm, F2.8 to F4.5, HFOV 71 deg to 4.05 deg (Telycam-published, product page plus 2026 catalog). App renders from published HFOV. Effective 16:9 width near 13.97mm derived as for the Explore 500 (working value pending manufacturer confirmation). Leaner output set than the 500 (no 12G-SDI, SFP+ or full NDI), PoE+. Built-in variable ND. Part TLC-900-IP-20-4K(NDI)-AB-XE-G2.

Telycam Explore Gen2 entry tier. Sony 1/1.8 inch 9MP UHD CMOS, 30x optical, f=6.91 to 214.64mm, F1.35 to F4.6. HFOV 63 deg (wide) to 2.1 deg (tele); Telycam-published (product page plus 2026 catalog). App renders from published HFOV. Published wide HFOV plus focal imply an effective 16:9 width near 8.47mm; sensorWidthMM and sensorHeightMM are effective 16:9 values derived from the published wide HFOV and focal (working values pending manufacturer confirmation). No built-in ND. Part TLC-900-IP-30-4K(NDI)-AB-G2.

Vision+ 4KN family, 12x variant. Sony 1/2.8 inch 9MP UHD CMOS, 12x optical, f=3.4 to 40.3mm, F1.8 to F3.6. HFOV 80.5 deg (wide) to 7.6 deg (tele), Telycam-published (product page plus 2026 catalog). App renders from published HFOV (POS-D01). sensorWidthMM and sensorHeightMM are effective 16:9 values from the published wide HFOV and wide focal (Optie A). Shares its optical block with the Vision+ SE. No built-in ND across product page and catalog (POS-D11). Part TLC-300-IP-12-4K(NDI)-AB.

Vision+ 4KN family, 20x variant. Sony 1/1.8 inch 9MP UHD CMOS, 20x optical, f=6.25 to 112.5mm, F1.58 to F3.95. HFOV 61 deg (wide) to 3.5 deg (tele), Telycam-published (product page plus 2026 catalog). App renders from published HFOV (POS-D01). Effective 16:9 sensor size from the published wide HFOV and wide focal (Optie A). Shares its optical block with the Vision+ 4KZ box camera. No built-in ND (POS-D11). Part TLC-700-IP-20-4K(NDI)-AB.

Vision+ 4KN family, 30x variant. Sony 1/1.8 inch 9MP UHD CMOS, 30x optical, f=6.91 to 214.64mm, F1.35 to F4.6. HFOV 63 deg (wide) to 2.1 deg (tele), Telycam-published (product page plus 2026 catalog). App renders from published HFOV (POS-D01). Effective 16:9 sensor size from the published wide HFOV and wide focal (Optie A); same optical block as the already-listed Explore 100 and the Vision+ N3 30x. No built-in ND (POS-D11). Part TLC-700-IP-30-4K(NDI)-AB.

Vision+ N3 family, 20x variant, 1080p60 tier. Sony 1/2.8 inch 2.4MP CMOS, 20x optical, f=4.9 to 98mm, F1.5 to F3. HFOV 55.8 deg (wide) to 3.2 deg (tele), Telycam-published (product page plus 2026 catalog). App renders from published HFOV (POS-D01). Effective 16:9 sensor size from the published wide HFOV and wide focal (Optie A). No built-in ND (POS-D11). Part TLC-300-IP-20(NDI)-AB.

Vision+ N3 family, 30x variant, 1080p60 tier. Sony 1/1.8 inch 9MP CMOS, 30x optical, f=6.91 to 214.64mm, F1.35 to F4.6. HFOV 63 deg (wide) to 2.1 deg (tele), Telycam-published (product page plus 2026 catalog). App renders from published HFOV (POS-D01). Effective 16:9 sensor size from the published wide HFOV and wide focal (Optie A); same optical block as the Explore 100 and the Vision+ 4KN 30x. A reseller lists this sensor as 1/1.28 inch; the Telycam product page and the shared optical block confirm 1/1.8 inch (POS-D04). No built-in ND (POS-D11). Part TLC-700-IP-30(NDI)-AB.

Vision+ SE, true 4K60 single-zoom PTZ with native auto-tracking. Sony 1/2.8 inch 9MP CMOS, 12x optical, f=3.4 to 40.3mm, F1.8 to F3.6. HFOV 80.5 deg (wide) to 7.6 deg (tele), Telycam-published (product page plus 2026 catalog). App renders from published HFOV (POS-D01). Effective 16:9 sensor size from the published wide HFOV and wide focal (Optie A); same optical block as the Vision+ 4KN 12x. Sold as an NDI/3G-SDI output model (part VP300-12-4KS) or an HDMI output model (part VP300-12-4KH); USB-C on both. No built-in ND (POS-D11). introductionYear inferred from the Vision+ line launch (2024).

Drive+ N family, 12x variant, entry tier 1080p60. Sony 1/2.8 inch 2.4MP CMOS, 12x optical, f=3.92 to 47.32mm, F1.8 to F2.8. HFOV 72.5 deg (wide) to 6.3 deg (tele), Telycam-published (product page plus 2026 catalog). App renders from published HFOV (POS-D01). Effective 16:9 sensor size from the published wide HFOV and wide focal (Optie A). NDI HX (not HX3). No built-in auto-tracking and no FreeD (entry tier; auto-tracking only via the V-JOY+ AT controller). No built-in ND (POS-D11). Part TLC-300-IP-12(NDI).

Drive+ N family, 20x variant, entry tier 1080p60. Sony 1/2.8 inch 2.4MP CMOS, 20x optical, f=5.2 to 98mm, F1.5 to F3.0. HFOV 55.8 deg (wide) to 3.2 deg (tele), Telycam-published product-page spec table (the product-page blurb rounds this to 60 deg; the spec table is authoritative, POS-W33). App renders from published HFOV (POS-D01). Effective 16:9 sensor size from the published wide HFOV and wide focal (Optie A). NDI HX (not HX3). No built-in auto-tracking and no FreeD. No built-in ND (POS-D11). Part TLC-300-IP-20(NDI).

Drive+ SE, entry tier 1080p60 with selectable SDI or HDMI output. Sony 1/2.8 inch 2.4MP CMOS, 20x optical, f=4.9 to 98mm, F1.5 to F3.0. HFOV 60 deg (wide) to 3.2 deg (tele), Telycam-published (manufacturer product-page spec table). App renders from published HFOV (POS-D01). Effective 16:9 sensor size from the published wide HFOV and wide focal (Optie A). NDI HX (not HX3). No built-in auto-tracking and no FreeD. No built-in ND (POS-D11). Sold as a 3G-SDI output model (part TLC-300-IP-20(NDI)-SE-SDI) or an HDMI output model (part TLC-300-IP-20(NDI)-SE-HDMI); USB-C on both. introductionYear inferred from the Drive+ line launch (2024).

Meet+ 12/20 conferencing PTZ pair, 12x variant, 1080p60. Panasonic 1/2.8 inch 2.4MP CMOS, 12x optical, f=3.92 to 47.32mm, F1.8 to F2.8. HFOV 72.5 deg (wide) to 6.3 deg (tele), Telycam-published (product page plus 2026 catalog); shares this optical block with the Drive+ N 12x. App renders from published HFOV (POS-D01). Effective 16:9 sensor size from the published wide HFOV and wide focal (Optie A). USB-C plus HDMI output only, no NDI, no SDI, no PoE (powered via USB-C or DC). No auto-tracking, no FreeD, no ND. Part TLC-300-HU2-12. introductionYear estimated from the Telycam 2024 lineup generation.

HFOV 60 deg (wide) to 3.2 deg (tele), Telycam-published (product page plus 2026 catalog); shares this optical block with the Drive+ SE. App renders from published HFOV (POS-D01). Effective 16:9 sensor size from the published wide HFOV and wide focal (Optie A). USB-C plus HDMI output only, no NDI, no SDI, no PoE (powered via USB-C or DC). No auto-tracking, no FreeD, no ND. Part TLC-300-HU2-20. introductionYear estimated from the Telycam 2024 lineup generation.
